answer: For agents certifying saffron shipments, cap the influence of any endorsement cluster by the capacity of its links to independently audited suppliers. Compute maximum flow from those trusted roots, with a fixed budget on each endorsement edge. A farm may let aliases wander through a dense internal graph, but extra internal edges create no additional flow across its boundary. A cipher signature prevents forged endorsements. To gain more weight, the attacker must obtain more scarce trusted links; captured roots remain a failure case.
